name: Angel One Ltd
title: Angel One Ltd - 543235 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 broking volumes rebounded (orders +13.3% QoQ to 431m, EB/DAT margin 41.7%, normalised 44.4%), but cash market share fell 117 bps QoQ and management guided only to flat employee cost and a 2.5-3% new-business drag.

triggers.label: Orders +13.3% QoQ to 431m
triggers.quote: orders executed on the platform increased by 13.3% sequentially to 431 million
triggers.highlight: orders executed on the platform increased by 13.3%

triggers.label: Employee cost flat FY27 vs FY26 (~₹11bn)
triggers.quote: we will likely be within the same range of the FY 2026 number, which is about ₹11 billion, including the ESOP cost
triggers.highlight: within the same range of the FY 2026 number

triggers.label: Cash share down 117 bps QoQ
triggers.quote: In cash, specifically, you are seeing a year -over-year drop of about 37 bps and a quarter-over-quarter drop of 117 bps.

triggers.label: Newer-business drag 2.5-3% for FY27
triggers.quote: for the current year we will have in the range bound of about 2.5 to 3%
triggers.highlight: in the range bound of about 2.5 to 3%

guidance.quote: we will likely be within the same range of the FY 2026 number, which is about ₹11 billion, including the ESOP cost

guidance.metric: Operating margin drag from newer businesses
guidance.quote: for the current year we will have in the range bound of about 2.5 to 3%

guidance.value: 25% to 26% of PBT as other businesses scale
guidance.quote: the tax rate will come to about 25% to 26% of the PBT
overall it will be about ₹1.5 billion, as we have been spending in the past as well

prior_guidance_check.quote: normalized EB DAT margin improved by 498 basis points sequentially to 44.4%

red_flags.label: Cash market share falling; March one-off ₹192m client reimbursement
red_flags.quote: a one-time reimbursement of ₹192 million to clients arising from an external market infrastructure disruption

red_flags.label: Cohort disclosure dropped from presentation
red_flags.quote: last year you disclosed the cohort analysis, this time it is missing in the PPT

evasions.topic: Cash market share and cohort data
evasions.quote: I wouldn't read too much into it. There isn't any meaningful shift on that.
Look, I won't give you a specific number on it.
Unfortunately, we don't share that number with anyone.
